nodes.name: Restconf MCP - Find which switch ports do not have port security  enabled for (device_name)

parameters.prompt:
Task: report the ports on ${trigger.device_name} that are not configured for port security.

Call find_unsecured_ports(device_name="${trigger.device_name}") exactly ONCE, then return your final answer immediately. Do not call it again to confirm -- its result is complete and already parsed (unsecured_ports, secured_ports, skipped, checked). Do not call get_restconf_data for this task.

Return the response_schema JSON as your final answer -- not as text before another tool call:
- Success: status "success", interfaces = unsecured_ports exactly as returned. An empty list is a valid success -- every port is already secured.
- Tool error: retry once only if the error looks transient; otherwise status "failed", the error text in error, interfaces empty. Never invent interface names.
- details: one short sentence summarising the result.

Only if you were explicitly asked for something beyond port security, use get_restconf_data(device_name, yang_path, fields, depth) with a fields projection, and put that answer in details.

details.description: Free-form answer for anything outside the port-security list

nodes.name: Condition - (True)  Fix Port Security | Else (False) Already Compliant

parameters.prompt:
You are remediating switch port security on ${trigger.device_name} via Ansible Automation Platform. A human approver has authorised this.

Ports to configure (use exactly this list, do not invent or omit any):
${activity_2d800174_e4a5_4919_83f3_5495b00ba78c.result.content.interfaces}

Steps:
1. Call job_templates_launch_create with id 159 (the "NETWORK | Port Security" job template) and requestBody:
   {"extra_vars": {"_hosts": "${trigger.device_name}", "interfaces": [<one string per port from the list above>]}}
   The playbook reads _hosts and interfaces; both are required.
2. Take the launched job id from the response. Call jobs_retrieve once with that id to read its status.

Output:
- Launched: status "success", job_id as a string, message naming the template, the device and how many ports were submitted.
- The launch call errored: status "failed", job_id "", message containing the error. Do not retry more than once.
- If the port list above is empty, do not launch anything: status "success", job_id "", message explaining there was nothing to remediate.

job_id.description: AAP job id of the launched job as a string; empty if nothing was launched

message.description: What was launched against which device and ports, or the error

parameters.prompt:
Port security remediation was REJECTED by the approver for ${trigger.device_name}.

These ports were found WITHOUT port security and remain unremediated:
${activity_2d800174_e4a5_4919_83f3_5495b00ba78c.result.content.interfaces}

Do not call any tools. Do not add, remove, reorder, rename or abbreviate any entry. Copy that list verbatim into unremediated_ports. Set device to ${trigger.device_name}. In message, state how many ports still need port security configured on that device and that no changes were made.

unremediated_ports.description: Ports still without port security, copied verbatim

extra_vars.closed_notes: All relevant ports configured for port security

device_name.description: Switch to check for port security: leaf1 or leaf2
